'''Jalanda son of [[Aried]] son of [[Coiam]]''' was an [[Ogier]] [[author]] and [[historian]].

==History==
Jalanda wrote that [[Be'lal]] was called the Envious because he envied [[Lews Therin]] as well as some of his fellow [[Forsaken]], [[Ishamael]] and [[Lanfear]].  [[Loial]] provides the information to [[Moiraine]] when she is trying to acquire information before trying to stop the plot to capture [[Rand]].{{ref/book|3|50}}
